notes.title: Song Pack Update
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas.
This was not planned for Christmas so there are no songs related to the holiday. 
The majority of the work just happened to be completed today.

There's still quite more to come so please keep an eye out for it.

As always we are still looking for help with a custom theme, steps, and songs so if you have an interest please reach out on our Discord.
